hypothesis: Joint training can reduce wrong-crop predictions by rewarding the total probability assigned to the labeled crop alongside the ordinary fine-label cross-entropy.
selection: Take each arm's best master validation checkpoint under the existing single-view macro-F1 tie rules. Rescore it with the same D4 policy on master validation and the grouped Sheikh, Mduma and Pakistan development data. Use the mean of the represented joint-label field macro-F1 scores for the screening decision.
purpose: A single-seed, full-training-split mechanistic screen. If it passes, repeat the comparison and investigate full-budget training. A pilot cannot replace the deployed model. Keep all course and follow-up test predictions sealed from this work.
method_reference: Bertinetto et al., Making Better Mistakes: Leveraging Class Hierarchies with Deep Networks, CVPR 2020. Competitive probability within the original 177 outputs means no extra classifier head and no inference code changes.
